facts: Rin Tin Tin was the first Hollywood dog star and he really signed his movie contracts – all 22 of them – with a paw-print.
Upright, stiff, rapid tail movement is not wagging or "friendly" but indicates a dog who's rather excited and focused.
The world's smallest dog was a Chihuahua named Miracle Milly, who weighed only 1.1 pounds.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect a drop of blood in a large swimming pool.
Dogs have a third eyelid called a nictitating membrane, which helps to protect their eyes and keep them moist.
